name: truenorth
display_name: IBM TrueNorth (28 nm, Merolla 2014): 4096 cores of 256 x 256 on a 64 x 64 mesh

named: 1-bit weights for the axon-type weight law
faithfulness.note: TrueNorth weighs a binary synapse by one of four per-neuron axon-type weights; the registered geometry declares 1-bit weights (scout_chip.md section 5.2), so a weight-quantized program on the bundle is not TrueNorth's weight law. Boundary: a signed 1-bit grid has no nonzero level (q_max 0), so weight quantization on this bundle is degenerate until both doors refuse weight_bits below 2 under signed weight quantization (key amendment filed with S0), and a float deployment never applies weight_bits, so it does not make the named approximation and runs float weights instead. The floorplan is the profile's 4096 cores on a 64 x 64 mesh, one core per tile (truenorth.json validity).
